result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major text truncation problem in the horizontal restaurant carousel, a minor bottom navigation state inconsistency, and a minor content cutoff at the bottom of the scroll area.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') has its restaurant name truncated mid-word at the right screen edge, and the card itself is cut off by the viewport with no visible scroll affordance or padding.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a peeking-card treatment with a subtle fade/scroll indicator so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable, and ensure card titles ellipsize gracefully rather than clipping mid-word at the screen boundary.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' highlighted in green (active state) while the visible screen is clearly the Home feed, creating an inconsistent active-tab indication.
issues.suggestion: Sync the active tab state with the currently displayed screen; the Home icon should be highlighted while the home feed is shown.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom content padding, making the list feel clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the tab bar height plus safe-area inset so the last card can scroll fully into view above the navigation.
